overview.text: In the legislature, she sponsored bills that became law regarding full-day kindergarten and equal pay scales. She also sponsored the Reproductive Health Privacy Act, which restricts sharing abortion-related medical records with out-of-state entities. In 2023, Canty sponsored a proposal for a $20 million state grocery initiative to provide grants to grocery stores in food deserts.
